fields.Name: Animals By Status
fields.UserQuestion: How many animals are in each status?
fields.Description: One row per Animal.Status with its count -- the shelter dashboard's composition bar. Grouped on the server rather than reading every animal to the browser and tallying there.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Returns Status, AnimalCount. No parameters. GROUP BY on vwAnimals.Status. A status with no animals does not appear, so the dashboard maps the result onto the full Status value list to keep every segment represented. No ORDER BY (illegal inside MJ's __count CTE wrapper) -- display order comes from the component, which knows the lifecycle sequence. Schema literal __mj.
